sloka: बलैः समग्रैर्यदि मां रावणं जित्यसंयुगे ।विजयी स्वपुरीं यायात् तत्तु मे स्याद्यशस्करम् ।। ५.३९.२९।।।।
transliteration: balaiḥ samagrairyadi māṁ rāvaṇaṁ jityasaṁyuge ।vijayī svapurīṁ yāyāt tattu me syādyaśaskaram ।। 5.39.29।।।।

translations.english: "It would be worthy of Rama if he with his entire army emerges victorious over Ravana in a battle and takes me to his city.
